message.content:
This editorial magazine cover features a white background with a red vertical border on the left and a red horizontal border on the bottom. The large red word "TEMPO" is positioned at the top center. Above it, black text reads "SIAPA MENEROR PENYIDIK KPK / MEMBONGKAR SINDIKAT FAKTUR PAJAK FIKTIF". Below the masthead, the date "20-26 JULI 2015" appears.

The central image is a typographic illustration forming the silhouette of a person sitting in a kneeling or prayer position, facing right. The shape is composed entirely of hand-drawn words in varying sizes and styles. Most text is black, except for the top portion (the head area), which is red and says "AGAR ISLAM TAK SATU WARNA". 

Other prominent black words within the body silhouette include "digugat di ibu kota", "tradiṣi membaca al-Quran dengan langgam lokal", "MUSABAQAH", "PRIBUMISASI", and "REAKSI atas gejala ARABISASI?". The person's raised hand is formed by the words "khusus diselenggarakan" and "CENGKOK LOKAL". In the bottom-left corner, price information "RP 39.500", a website, and a barcode are visible.
